ASUS Prime 750W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply


Fuel your gaming rig with reliable, efficient, and durable energy using the ASUS Prime 750W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply. Engineered for mainstream PC builders and gamers, this high-quality power supply unit (PSU) delivers a continuous 750W of clean power, making it the perfect backbone for modern high-performance graphics cards and multi-core processors. With its 80 Plus Bronze certification, it guarantees up to 85% efficiency under typical workloads, reducing heat output, power consumption, and your energy bill.


The ASUS Prime 750W features an advanced cooling solution driven by a durable dual ball bearing fan, ensuring exceptional airflow and quiet operation even during intense gaming sessions or heavy rendering tasks. Its stylish, dual-tone black and white aesthetic adds a premium look that seamlessly blends into any modern PC chassis design. Equipped with comprehensive power protection safeguards (including OPP, OVP, UVP, SCP, and OCP), this heavy-duty PSU guarantees ultimate stability, safety, and peace of mind for your entire build.
